_README: SHADDAI credit economics — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what actions cost users and what plans grant. Credits are the billing-service unit (~$0.001 each internally, treated as abstract units). Outcome/hybrid model: cheap fast chat on Groq/local = 1 credit; premium/cloud strong chat + heavy generation cost more. BYOK (user brought their own API key) = 0 credits, never debited, never blocked. Tune the numbers here; billing-service.js debitForAction() and the dashboard both read this file. Action ids must match what brains.js / route handlers pass.

fast_chat.label: Agent chat — fast model (Groq / local Ollama)

strong_chat.label: Agent chat — strong/cloud model (Claude / GPT / 70B / OpenRouter / Ollama Cloud)
